name: 19506 · Bernville, PA
findings: ZIP 19506 (Bernville) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (85%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19506 (Bernville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19506 (Bernville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 8% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
